provenance.geometry_and_field: Prescribed theoretical baseline; lab z is the common NV axis.
provenance.gamma_e: Signed Hamiltonian convention: -2*pi*28024.95 rad/us/T; magnitude from Joas et al., PRX 15, 021069 (2025).
provenance.bare_detuning: Chosen zero reference-minus-transition detuning before dipolar projection shifts.
provenance.units: Positions: m; fields: T; gradients: T/m; D, E and detuning: rad/us; gamma_e: rad/us/T.
provenance.constraints: Chosen trial bounds: minimum separation 5 nm and maximum field magnitude 20 mT at NV sites; not validated fabrication or hardware limits.

limits: No physical addressing or finite-pulse response.
